error: RuntimeError: live capture on ':0' did not become ready
root_cause: ffmpeg raw PCM output buffering withheld filesystem growth beyond the three-second readiness deadline at 16 kHz stereo, although AVFoundation was recording

diagnostic_evidence.pre_fix_threaded_capture_behavior: ready signal arrived only after the capture process closed

fix: pass -flush_packets 1 to the ffmpeg raw muxer so raw byte count is a live stream-position signal; track actual playback invocation so a pre-playback failure is not mislabeled live playback
raw_report_correction: The immutable attempt-1 result says live_playback=true because the original runner equated real-I/O mode with playback. Coordinator ordering and zero completed captures establish that playback was never invoked.
retry_boundary: A second full protocol attempt requires separately frozen predictor and I/O-runner hashes and fresh explicit operator authorization.
